case_scope: OECD long-term care affordability, asset spenddown, and family burden

household_market_extraction_gate.note: LTC costs, access gaps, and informal-care reliance can convert nominal late-life wealth into temporary care payment reserve.

long_term_care_asset_spenddown.note: OECD affordability evidence shows public systems often leave severe care needs and low-income older people exposed to poverty or high out-of-pocket burden.

disability_care_interruption.note: Access and availability constraints shift burden to families.

pension_housing_age_hidden_wealth.note: Housing and pension wealth cannot be counted at face value until care costs, means tests, co-payments, and estate-recovery/home-equity treatment are netted out. Rev0344 unused-source burn-down: OECD gender-pension-gap evidence is now bound to late-life care, pension, housing, and sex-disaggregated asset-spenddown risk.

family_gatekeeper_dependence.note: Informal care can become family-gated wealth security.

care_market_availability.note: Formal access, home-care coverage, worker supply, waiting lists, and institutional/home setting design must be scored separately from affordability.

informal_care_family_burden.note: Informal care is a major source of support and disproportionately relies on women; certification must count family labor, retirement, and career loss.

proof_debt: out-of-pocket formal care cost by need severity, income, wealth, sex, and age
poverty risk after public support and care costs
asset tests, home equity, estate recovery, and means-test cliff design
waiting lists, home-care availability, worker supply, and quality
family-carer labor, earnings, pension, and health loss
unmet need and substitution between formal, informal, and institutional care

gate_16_household_market_extraction.why: LTC affordability/access remains blocked until public support prevents severe-need spenddown, poverty risk, and unmet care.

gate_19_intergenerational_transfer.why: Family transfers and home equity cannot be certified without netting out care cost, estate-recovery, and informal-care labor burden.

evidence_debt_register.question: out-of-pocket cost by need severity, income, wealth, sex, and age
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Use OECD affordability evidence to score severe/moderate needs by income/wealth group and setting.

evidence_debt_register.question: poverty risk after public support and care costs
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Estimate poverty and unmet-need exposure after benefits, copayments, and board/lodging charges.

evidence_debt_register.question: asset tests, home equity, estate recovery, and means-test cliffs
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Compare how pension/housing wealth is treated across OECD systems and whether home equity is protected or liquidated.

evidence_debt_register.question: waiting lists and home-care availability
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Track access to home care, institutional care, formal workers, assessment delays, and geographic supply constraints.

evidence_debt_register.question: family-carer labor and pension loss
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Measure informal-care hours, gender distribution, employment reduction, pension contribution loss, and respite support.

evidence_debt_register.question: unmet need and setting substitution
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Distinguish affordability from actual service availability and quality in home versus institutional care.

policy_pathway: Treat long-term care as a late-life threshold moment that can erase prior wealth formation.
Require universal/near-universal need assessment, public cost protection, home-care access, caregiver supports, estate/home-equity clarity, and poverty-risk monitoring.
validation_notes: rev0314 bounded active proxy case; not a full jurisdictional certification.
rev0334 removed stale household_market_extraction_gate_seed calibration label; active status now depends on product-specific current-law, price/fee, remedy, and time-to-harm evidence.
rev0341 status-language repair: stale seed-status wording removed from active scoreboard narrative without changing verdict, blocked gates, source_refresh_due, or evidence burden.
rev0344 binds formerly unused source S66 to `pension_housing_age_hidden_wealth` so active evidence lineage no longer leaves this source floating outside a case.
